g.text: BFI Presenter needs no frame limiter acting on the game.
Remove ReLimiter and set the RTSS limit to 0.
Turn installed mods off and on without uninstalling them. Their
files and settings stay in the game folder.
Off: kept in the game folder, not loaded
Applied when the game starts, whether you press Play here or
launch it from its store, and undone when it closes.
